scope: Fresh frozen-baseline prediction comparison. No production integration, changed defaults, live candidate decisions, persona changes, new core learning or tuned controllers.
conditioning: Next opponent intent conditional only on public pre-state and strictly earlier revealed intents. No current own intent, actual controller label, actual seed or hidden RNG enters predictor. Opaque per-game namespace is identity only. This is observational prediction on fixed paths, not counterfactual gameplay evaluation.

matrix.controlled: 3 existing authored scenes (friendly_convergence, enemy_convergence, mixed_junction) x goals secure/both x 4 unchanged profiles = 24 games. Fresh seed 1701 + (cell_index + profile_index) % 2; six cells in scene-major secure/both order. Each profile gets three games per seat, each cell two profiles per seat. Mirror geometry and owners using existing authored_world. 24-tick deadline.
matrix.heldout: 4 existing cells (open/secure/reference, choke/eliminate/switch, open/either/raider, choke/both/reference) x 4 unchanged profiles x fresh seeds 1701/1702 = 32 games. Both seats for every cell/profile. Standard starts, 40-tick deadline.
matrix.freshness: All 56 game IDs are new and disjoint from the previous 64 baseline IDs. Scenes/controller families are familiar; heldout is fresh stochastic trajectories, not novel distributions or external validation.
matrix.budget: Exactly 56 full baseline games, at most 8 processes (default 4), existing bounded default planner. No replacement seeds, favorable exclusions, or optional stopping. Unit and synthetic mechanism tests are not experimental games. No full experiment until source/test/design preregistration is frozen.

baseline: Existing validation_experiment.combat, mode baseline, learn=True with only actual feedback, survival_security=True, progress_watch=True, TacticalControl defaults (self_continuation objective), recovery_options=True, trace_execution=True, root_completion=False. No new predictor imports in production modules or new prediction input to planner. Unchanged fixed profiles asserted. Save full raw traces and replay rules, progress, intent legality, continuous states, exact initial states, terminal completion and saved original first-step hypotheses.
goal_experts: The two goal hypotheses are eliminate/secure; experts use only existing public tactical_scores and fixed softmax temperature 0.04. Active public routes mask inactive goals. Smoothing 0.08 applies to likelihood experts and forecast experts. Existing unchanged HypothesisTracker, retention 0.9, responsive=False. Its heuristic confidence is not used. This is bounded online likelihood weighting, not verified identification of hidden goals.
memory: One independent mutable wrapper per game and living observing individual, separate bounded tracker for each opposing actor. Never share across owners, opponents or games. Construct all immutable forecasts before reading current revealed choices; score before atomic reveal/update. Stop updates for dead observers. Canonical smallest living owner supplies one categorical forecast per opponent/tick, with all living owners asserted identical for the same public history.

methods.uniform: U: product of independent rule-legal uniform opponent distributions
methods.fixed: F: original two equally weighted JOINT intent hypotheses with their dependence preserved
methods.fixed_coverage: 0.8 F + 0.2 U as an outer joint mixture
methods.goal_uniform: 0.8 G_equal + 0.2 U; G_equal is the product of per-opponent equally weighted active goal expert distributions
methods.goal_adaptive: 0.8 G_weighted + 0.2 U; G_weighted is the product of independently likelihood-weighted active goal expert distributions

metrics: Every legal move destination for every living owner each tick, selected or not, including unreachable structural negatives. Binary occupancy event is at least one opposing attempted intent to that destination, not successfully resolved position. Also report enemy-reachable and actually selected subsets separately.

Full categorical intent Brier sums all legal-action indicator errors within each actor prediction, then averages predictions. True natural-log loss and infinite/zero-support counts. Do not count the same public event once per observer.

Binary Brier, true log loss (JSON null plus positive infinite count when infinite), separately named epsilon=1e-12 clipped log loss, zero-probability misses, probability-one false positives, 10 fixed equal-width calibration bins and descriptive ECE. Intent calibration flattens all legal indicators; it is a separate diagnostic, not multiclass Brier or proof of calibration.

Pooled event-weighted and equal-game means separately for both partitions, every profile, every scenario and every actual controller group. Equal-game means omit and count empty domains rather than filling a zero; infinities remain infinite. All per-game method scores are retained. Report adaptive-minus-uniform/fixed_coverage/goal_uniform differences and numbers improved/worsened/tied.

Declared switch driver before/after tick 8 is an offline report split only; labels and switch time are never supplied to predictor. No significance or independent-sample claim from correlated ticks, actors, duplicated candidate cells or shared scenarios.
primary_gate: To justify only a separately reviewed exploratory live paired test, goal_adaptive must strictly lower BOTH categorical intent and reachable-cell occupancy Brier AND true log loss against BOTH uniform and fixed_coverage on EACH controlled/heldout partition, under BOTH pooled-event and equal-game weighting. Missing or infinite candidate/control means fail the gate. This is a prespecified descriptive threshold, not statistical proof. Any failure stops at offline prediction; no seed additions or tuning. A pass does not authorize integration or demonstrate gameplay benefit.
ablation: Report goal_adaptive versus goal_uniform separately, using identical experts/support/coverage. Better support is not evidence that online goal inference helps. Profile/scenario regressions, calibration deterioration, equal-game reversals and zero support must remain visible even if primary gate passes.
freeze: Before first full game, write immutable preregister.json containing all 56 jobs, all reflex Python source SHA-256, all test Python SHA-256, this design, old authored-geometry design, pyproject, cost script, planner config and checkout head. Verify unchanged before/after generation and offline scoring. Persist baseline input SHA-256 before scoring; reject incomplete/mismatched/reused inputs. Do not overwrite existing preregistration or artifacts.
cost: Report baseline game wall time, planner calls/model transitions/planner seconds separately from offline forecast/reveal time. Fixed first controlled state, 20 forecast warmups then 200 serial samples for all living owners. Serialized memory byte count is not Python heap size. Fixed numeric and recursive memory cost require separate explicit measurement. No claim of real-time NPC throughput or benefit-cost from offline prediction timings. Separate fixed cost script measures original fixed hypotheses versus goal forecasts plus all legal movement queries; recursive retained Python heap after 16 synthetic reveals; isolated generic-core batches of 1/32/128 observers, each with three opponents. These synthetic replicas are not a many-actor shared-world game benchmark.
review: Unit contracts and separate independent source/formula review before final conclusions. No push, PR or integration without parent review. No retuning after outcomes.
